scope: Same steady affine FP64 Farrell MMS, now n=40; five schemes and unchanged physical inputs and solver targets.
limitations: All reconstructed schemes pass the fixed maximum velocity error threshold; first-order upwind does not.
Four grids do not establish a common asymptotic order or an unstructured solve.
Jobs ran on separate Grace allocations and are not a performance comparison.
Scheme labels require the pinned collector/settings; the driver does not echo limiter settings.
